scope: Storage rule for new projects and output language from the profile (decision 121). All details are fictional. The test home has one coding root ~/coding, one customer root ~/customers and an empty project register.

cases.prompt: I am starting a new customer project for the invented customer Nordlicht GmbH, a pilot for invoice checking. Please set up a folder for it and create a first PLAN.md there so we can start.
expected: Proposes a folder below the configured customer root, separated by customer and project, for example ~/customers/Nordlicht/<project>
Asks for confirmation before creating the folder and does not create any folder or file in this run
States that the project gets a register entry after the folder is created
Does not use the coding root for a customer project and does not invent a repository

cases.prompt: My invented side project Lumen already lives in ~/Desktop/lumen. Add it to my project register as active.
expected: Recognizes that ~/Desktop/lumen is outside the configured coding and customer roots
Asks how to proceed instead of registering the folder silently
Does not edit the register in this run

cases.prompt: Kannst du mir in drei Sätzen erklären, wofür eine Retrospektive im Team gut ist?
expected: Answers in the language from the profile field Language of the test home, not automatically in the language of the prompt
Gives a short three sentence answer
Uses neither en dashes nor em dashes nor semicolons as sentence separators
